title: Wait for new thread responses; add searchable channel queries
summary: Owner asked whether a worker can wait for new replies on a channel thread, then expanded the request to searchable text with pagination, complex queries, channel and author filters. The Development Lead proposed channel_read follow:{until} and structured search; owner approved thread follow, and later specified a 2-second grace poll before registering the follow. Follow has no delivered implementation evidence: its Task remains open and branch feat/thread-follow is still at unrelated commit e830baa. Structured search is implemented in commit 74d1fd3 on feat/structured-search, but that commit is not an ancestor of current HEAD; its Task remains open and branch-only criteria require test/clean-commit report. Later fuzzy matching, @author, channel rows and rendered/highlighted excerpts are implemented in commit b61c1a9 on main's history context but not current HEAD; canonical Task task_01a10b37-e7d8-7689-b16f-98254db2f8d5 remains open. No run of tests or live MCP verification was performed in this review. Nothing is marked dropped: both canonical tasks are active/open.
nextAction: Buddies Development Lead: resume the thread-follow worker on its branch and complete revision-2 criteria, including 2-second grace, unread immediate return, post-grace wake, already-read no-turn, timeout, restart survival, required integration tests, and clean-commit verification; separately coordinate branch integration/review of structured-search commit 74d1fd3 and fuzzy-search commit b61c1a9, reconcile with the open search Task's required criteria, then verify tests and runtime behavior before closing Tasks.
